contractName: Legacy Alpaca AF1.0 ibUSDT lending vault proxy
admissionBlocker: The exact attributed ibUSDT proxy reports implementation 0x7684966f3A3d679939622eF0260EC9A20318e981. No deployment-applicable implementation ABI/source could be retrieved or bound: Sourcify returns 404 and BscScan's address-bound readContract endpoint explicitly reports no matching Contract ABI or SourceCode. The pinned official repository contains no occurrence of this implementation address. The full proxy administration ABI below is NOT a lending implementation ABI and does not establish deposit/withdraw availability. No capabilities are admitted.

deploymentEvidence.sourceType: Pinned official BSC mainnet deployment configuration plus exact-chain/address proxy verification
deploymentEvidence.evidence: Vaults entry named Interest Bearing USDT, symbol ibUSDT, binds this address, deployment block 7732507, base token, debt token and configuration. Official hardhat.config.ts maps mainnet to BSC_MAINNET_RPC; the exact-address Sourcify chain-56 record corroborates the proxy deployment identity. This is the legacy ordinary lending vault, not an AF2.0 Money Market or leveraged-worker admission.
limitations: Sourcify proxyResolution is an evidence-service observation, not an independent current storage, bytecode or implementation-persistence attestation.

The proxy record has runtimeMatch match rather than exact_match, creationMatch null and no deployment transaction metadata. Its verified proxy source has different compiler metadata and constructor details; it is not evidence of the actual original initializer arguments or initial implementation.
Official .mainnet.json identifies historical dependency addresses, not current stored token, config, owner, administrator, rates, reserve settings, liquidity or shutdown configuration.
The official repository main snapshot is dated 2024-07-08 and cannot by itself establish the interface of the different implementation reported at review.

abiEvidence.sourceType: Exact-address verified proxy administration ABI ONLY; implementation ABI unavailable
abiEvidence.evidence: Top-level abi preserves the entire returned proxy ABI: constructor, two events, fallback, five administrative functions and receive. The applicable implementation ABI and its full function inventory are unknown; no generic Vault.sol, IVault, fork, old implementation or inferred selector ABI is substituted.

historicalLendingModel.scope: Historical official source context ONLY; expressly not bound to the reported deployed implementation and not used as ABI evidence
risksAndLimitations: Historical totalToken includes cash plus vaultDebtVal minus reservePool. Borrower debt and accrued interest are not immediately withdrawable cash: utilization, borrower repayment, liquidation losses, reserves and available USDT can constrain exits. No current balance, solvency, interest rate or redemption readiness is attested.

Historical deposit pulls configured ERC20 tokens from msg.sender and mints ib shares to msg.sender; withdraw burns the caller's shares and transfers assets to that caller. There is no receiver argument. Third-party funding or share staking/unstaking is not included, and token approval is a separate unadmitted operation.

Historical deposit is payable only to support configured wrapped-native vaults; nonzero native value requires token == configured wrapped-native token and amount == msg.value. The official ibUSDT base token is BSC USDT, not BNB/WBNB: an ordinary historical USDT deposit uses ERC20 allowance and zero native value; historical withdraw is nonpayable. Current behavior remains unestablished.

Historical share and asset conversion divides with integer rounding, has a minimum remaining total-share-supply constraint, and offers no caller-set min-shares, min-assets, max-input or deadline. There is no explicit lender cooldown in the examined historical deposit/withdraw bodies; current implementation or shutdown restrictions remain unknown.

Historical interest accrual reads configurable interest-rate and reserve settings. Configured token behavior, config contract, reserves, and administrative changes can affect accounting or revert execution. The whitelisted contract-caller restriction in historical Vault.sol applies to work, not the examined ordinary deposit/withdraw bodies; this does not establish caller compatibility of the unknown current implementation.

frontendReference.evidence: Retrieved archived official homepage links Launch AF1.0 to app.alpacafinance.org and links the same official GitHub repository. Archived AF1.0 application returns Alpaca Finance metadata. Use the archive as the frontend reference; live app retrieval failed to connect and no currently usable frontend is claimed.
frontendReference.liveRetrievalResult: Unable to connect; official docs retrieval also failed to connect. No known parked domain is advertised as a working frontend.

lifecycleEvidence.evidence: Xangle preserves the Alpaca Finance Wind-Down Announcement and explicitly attributes its original publication to the official Alpaca Finance Medium post. Retrieved serialized article content announces sunsetting all products and commits to keeping the frontend running through 31 December 2025 for withdrawals. This is a legacy/shutdown candidate as of review, not evidence of a currently supported or economically safe lending service.
limitations: The frontend-support date has passed; no current frontend, maintenance, deposit enablement, exit availability or implementation semantics is inferred from the historical announcement.
Shutdown status does not justify substituting an old ABI, bypassing proxy binding, granting opaque worker execution or treating deposits as currently available.
